input.quote: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.2 gives Vendor ownership of the Deliverables we pay to have created and leaves us only a revocable, non-transferable, term-limited licence, which fails even the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable licence). Customer Data ownership in Section 14.1 and the no-joint-ownership rule in 14.4 are fine; we have reversed the Deliverable assignment and added a perpetual licence back-stop, leaving Vendor Technology with Vendor.

input.quote: Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets our preferred position: Affiliates and contractors are covered, paid-up and embedded Vendor Technology licences are perpetual and irrevocable, licence rights transfer to an Affiliate or successor, and revocation/suspension is limited to material uncured breach after notice and cure. The separate defect is the Deliverable licence in Section 14.2, flagged under the IP rule.

input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer.
input.rationale: Section 22 matches our preferred position: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable by an independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to our systems or unrelated data.

input.quote: After thirty consecutive days, Customer may terminate the affected Order Form without penalty and receive a refund of prepaid Fees for the unavailable period.
input.rationale: There is no liquidated-damages, penalty or minimum-fee-on-termination provision payable by us; Section 21.3 confirms only undisputed Fees for conforming Services are owed and Section 27.3 allows penalty-free termination. The take-or-pay exposure in Section 2.1 is a minimum commitment and is flagged once, under MINCOMMIT.
